title: Transition of Care: Honoring a Prior Plan's Authorization
content:
**Continuity of care policy — Prior Authorization.**

1. A new Prairie Ridge Health Plan member's authorization from the prior health plan is honored without a new medical necessity review, from any provider including out-of-network ones where the class honors out-of-network servicing providers.
2. A transition-of-care request is accepted only when received no later than the class's transition period in days after the member's plan coverage start date. The transition days are counted in calendar days from the day after the coverage start date, and a request on the last day still qualifies.
3. The honored authorization ends on the earlier of the prior authorization's end date and the last day of the transition period, and requires the prior plan's authorization number where the class requires it.
4. After the transition period the service needs an ordinary request.

**Retired wording.** The clause that the prior-plan authorization is honored "for the units the prior authorization had left" is **no longer in force**. The units a transition-of-care request asks for are governed by the plan's current transition-of-care basis for those units.

## The transition window, restated

| Element | Content |
|---|---|
| Event the clock starts from | the member's plan coverage start date, as shown on the member's Medicaid Managed Care Membership record |
| Counting | calendar days, the day after the coverage start date being day 1 |
| Length | the class's transition period in days |
| Direction and boundary | the request is received no later than the last day; a request on the last day qualifies |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

For a hypothetical member in a class with a 90-day transition period:

- a transition-of-care request received on the 90th calendar day after the coverage start date is accepted;
- a request received on the 91st calendar day after the coverage start date is not accepted as a transition-of-care request, and the service needs an ordinary request.

## End date of the honored authorization (hypothetical)

| Prior authorization's end date | Last day of the transition period | Honored authorization ends |
|---|---|---|
| 20 days before the last transition day | the 90th day | the prior authorization's end date |
| 30 days after the last transition day | the 90th day | the last day of the transition period |

superseded_clauses: for the units the prior authorization had left
